source_presence_check.method: rg --files assets-src/moto-components matched names spark/ignition.coil/plug.cap/intake/carbur/fuel.tap/fuel.pipe/fuel.hose; no matching dedicated asset source path at snapshot. Current head remaining-visible-features explicitly lists plug/cap/lead and intake adapters unmade.
source_presence_check.limit: No exhaustive Blender collection inspection; distinct named source absence is not proof that no anonymous placeholder exists. No completed-state or artistic acceptance inferred.

do_not_infer: No twin-spark from brand names, two tappet covers, two valves, two catalogue alternatives or two empty gas ports.
No exactRDC PRZ9HC/UR4AC, electrode reach/thread/rating/diameter from related catalogue labels.
No second plug added to chosen UG5 casting from unrelated CT ignition table.
No HT wire route synthesized from cockpit sheaths.
No currentRDC carb copied from D04/D15 code alone.
No hidden fuel filter, carb mechanism, combustion chamber or concealed wiring fabricated.
